properties.name: zone_port_approach
properties.label: Korsor port and east-bridge approach zone
properties.source_note: Redesigned after AIS-density audit. Represents the Korsor-side port/approach and manoeuvring area adjacent to the East Bridge traffic route. Informed by BELTREP / Great Belt VTS context; not an official port-limit polygon.

properties.name: zone_anchor_or_waiting_area
properties.label: Kalundborg and Jammerland waiting-area zone
properties.source_note: Redesigned after AIS low-speed cluster audit. Covers the Kalundborg/Jammerland waiting and anchorage-relevant area mentioned in BELTREP routeing context. Not an official anchorage boundary.

properties.name: zone_narrow_passage_control
properties.label: Sprogoe and East Bridge narrow-passage control zone
properties.source_note: Redesigned after AIS-density audit. Tightened around the Sprogoe / East Bridge controlled passage instead of covering the wider surrounding water. Informed by BELTREP provisions for the East Bridge traffic route; not an official TSS polygon.
